title: Escape on 13th
specs: Four uniquely themed rooms: pirates, sci-fi, magic, ancient Egypt
Located next to Nightmare on 13th haunted attraction
Highly immersive sets with film-quality design and spatial audio
No experience required; Game Masters brief every group
Rooms fit 2–10 players depending on room
Comfortable clothes and closed-toe shoes recommended
Private bookings for all groups; no strangers included
Multiple rooms can be booked simultaneously for groups 10 to 40+
Custom group events and corporate team building available
includes: Game Master monitoring and hint system
blurb: Guests choose from four themed escape rooms and have 60 minutes to solve puzzles and escape. Each booking is 100% private with no strangers. The experience includes a Game Master who monitors and provides hints, and a themed souvenir photo.
extraNote: Cancellation and rescheduling subject to availability; contact at least 24 hours in advance · Late arrivals may reduce in-room time · Group bookings require deposit to confirm · 342 W 1300 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84115, next to Nightmare on 13th haunted attraction
